purpose: Define Topic inheritance so a Topic may inherit broader Topic classifications and a recursive reader can resolve the full semantic grouping graph.

topics.name: Topic Inheritance
topics.purpose: Define Topic inheritance so a Topic may inherit broader Topic classifications and a recursive reader can resolve the full semantic grouping graph.

semantics.inheritance_rule: Topic may reference one or more parent Topics.
semantics.multi_parent_rule: Multiple parent Topics are valid when the child genuinely spans several semantic groupings.
semantics.transitive_rule: Inherited Topic membership is recursively resolvable.
semantics.identity_rule: Child Topic retains its own identity and does not merge into parent identity.
semantics.structure_rule: Topic inheritance is classification inheritance, not structural containment.
semantics.cycle_rule: Inheritance cycles must be explicitly valid under the Topic model or hard-fail.

invariants.rule: Every machine-significant canonical node is classified by explicit Topic membership or explicitly marked outsider; Topics may inherit and compose other Topics.

hard_gates.condition: Topic inheritance collapses child identity into parent
multiple parent Topics rejected without semantic reason
recursive inherited Topic resolution is impossible

prose.summary: Define Topic inheritance so a Topic may inherit broader Topic classifications and a recursive reader can resolve the full semantic grouping graph.
